# Toolathlon memory service

The npm manifest and lock are the VFS-Bench 1 `vendor/memory-mcp` files at commit `3f45f90f620c8096dd85bbe854b757eae1231392`. They select the original MIT-licensed `@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory` version 2025.4.25. `course-tools.json` contains the memory, fetch and web-search declarations from that revision’s `setup/toolathlon/cli_tools.json`. Course Schedule's v1 web capture is empty. The adapter returns a fixture miss for unavailable URLs and queries.
